replaceUnsupportedHelp: Replacement is unavailable in read-only, publish, or preview mode. Formulas, databases, HTML, Mermaid, document titles, rich-text table cells, and complex formatting also cannot be replaced. Regex mode supports $1, $&, and similar replacement syntax
replaceCurrentUnsupported: This match spans complex formatting or read-only content and cannot be replaced directly
replaceStaleTarget: The target changed. Replacement was cancelled and results refreshed. Review them and try again.
replaceRegexBudgetExceeded: Regex data or replacement output is too large. Narrow the search scope or reduce matches and replacement output.
replaceAttributeViewUnsupported: Database results support search and highlight only; replacement is not supported
replaceMermaidUnsupported: Mermaid diagrams support search and highlight only; replacement is not supported
replaceHtmlBlockUnsupported: HTML blocks support search and highlight of rendered text only; replacement is not supported
replaceCustomBlockUnsupported: Custom blocks are rendered by plugins and cannot be replaced directly
replaceTableRichUnsupported: Rich-text table cells support search and highlight only; replacement is not supported
replaceTableCellEditingUnsupported: This cell is being edited. Click outside the cell to finish editing, then replace
replaceTablePendingEdit: This table still has an edit that has not been saved. Click outside the cell, then replace
replaceModeUnsupported: Replacement is unavailable in publish, export preview, or read-only mode
replaceDocTitleUnsupported: The document title can be searched, but it is not included in replace
replaceDocTitleFailed: Failed to rename the document title
replaceAllConfirm: Scope: {scope}. {matchCount} matches: {count} will be replaced and {skippedCount} skipped (document titles, embeds, databases, formulas, rendered Mermaid/HTML text, rich-text cells, and complex formatting cannot be replaced). Continue?
replaceAllScopeFocus: Focused block and its content (using search settings)
replaceAllIncomplete: Search results are still incomplete. Wait for indexing or adjust the search scope before replacing all.
replaceCommitUnknown: Replacement is not fully confirmed ({replacedCount}/{submittedCount} confirmed). If this persists or SiYuan reports a transaction error, reload the document and search again. Check the content before retrying.
replaceCommitFailed: Replacement submission encountered an error. Check the content before continuing.
replaceProtyleMissing: Cannot find a writable Protyle editor; replace aborted to keep undo available
selectionOnlyNoScope: Selection-only mode is on, but there is no usable selection
searchDegradedLoadedOnly: This environment cannot query unloaded content. Results include only what is already loaded.
searchPartialIndexing: Still indexing the rest of the document. Current results may be incomplete
searchUnrendered: {count} blocks could not be fully indexed and were not counted
searchTruncated: {count} databases reached the page limit; their results are incomplete
resultsTypeFilterHint: Click block icons to filter; right-click heading, list or code icons for subtypes
resultsTypeFilterActive: Temporary filter: match all selected types
settingsRestrictInlineHint: When enabled, search only within the selected inline elements (multi-select). With an empty search box, preview all matching inline elements of the selected types. Limit-search choices reset when the search UI closes
settingsIncludeScopeHint: Controls which block-level types (and inline memos) may be searched
settingsIncludeMermaidHint: Match visible text rendered in Mermaid diagrams; fall back to source when not rendered
settingsIncludeFlowchartHint: Match visible text rendered in flowchart diagrams; fall back to source when not rendered
settingsIncludeHtmlBlockHint: Match visible rendered text inside HTML blocks, not the HTML source
settingsIncludeFoldedBlocksHint: Controls whether to search hidden content inside folded blocks
settingsIncludeInlineMemoHint: Matches show a yellow/orange dashed underline under the corresponding text; replacement is supported and can be undone with Ctrl+Z
settingsRestrictInlineMathHint: Match visible rendered formula text rather than LaTeX source
settingsRestrictInlineMemoHint: Turn on Include in search → Inline memos first
settingsRestrictInlineMemoOnHint: Turn on Include in search → Inline memos first
